_meta.edition_relevance: Trip window 15 Feb - 23 Mar 2027 sits entirely inside the Beijing low season (1 Nov - 31 Mar) and inside the Spring Festival tail (Golden Week ended 13 Feb 2027; Lantern Festival 20 Feb 2027).
rules: Hours, closing days and ticket prices are quoted only from the operator's own site where that site printed them as text.
Where an operator's site publishes only an image or a script-driven shop for prices, the price is left blank and flagged.
Third-party guide figures are never promoted to a verified price. They may be named inside a flag so the reader knows what to double-check.
Two-adult totals are only filled where the per-person price itself is verified.
_meta.season_note: Low-season (winter) hours apply for the whole of the trip window. Every venue below that publishes seasonal hours publishes shorter winter hours.

activities.name: The Palace Museum (Forbidden City)
activities.days: Tuesday to Sunday; closed Mondays except Chinese national holidays. Closed on Chinese New Year's Eve.
activities.exceptions: Mondays closed. City may close it at short notice - the official page carries a 'temporary closure' notice slot. No tickets sold on the day of the visit.
activities.price_note: Low-season entry CNY 40. Optional add-ons CNY 10 Treasure Gallery and CNY 10 Gallery of Clocks.
activities.price_two_adults_note: Entry only, 2 x CNY 40 low season. Excludes the two CNY 10 galleries.
activities.booking: Must book in advance online with passport number. Daily cap 40,000 visitors.
activities.flag: The 40,000 cap is the operator's own published figure and is unusually low for a site this size in a holiday period - book the moment the window opens. Lantern Festival (20 Feb 2027) falls inside the trip.

activities.name: National Museum of China
activities.days: Tuesday to Sunday; closed Mondays except Chinese national public holidays
activities.exceptions: Closed Mondays. Free but reservation-only. Reservations open 7 days ahead, released daily at 17:00. Three entry slots: 09:00-11:00, 11:00-13:30, 13:30-16:00. Late arrivals are refused entry.
activities.price_note: Admission free. Online real-name reservation with passport required.
activities.booking: Book at pcticket.chnmuseum.cn. One reservation per account per week, up to 5 people. No-shows (3 cumulative) block reservations for 30 days.
activities.flag: Reservation rules are strict and quota-limited (1 booking per account per week). Book this and the Forbidden City on different days, or from two accounts.

activities.name: Temple of Heaven Park
activities.days: Park open daily. The three main halls (Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, Echo Wall, Circular Mound Altar) close on Mondays except on national holidays.
activities.hours_low: Park 06:30-22:00, last entry 21:00. Halls 08:00-17:00, last entry 16:30 (1 Nov - 31 Mar)
activities.hours_high: Park 06:00-22:00, last entry 21:00. Halls 08:00-18:00, last entry 17:30 (1 Apr - 31 Oct)
activities.exceptions: Halls closed Mondays all year, open on national holidays. Last park entry one hour before closing.
activities.booking: Online ticketing linked from the official guide page.
activities.flag: The official park page publishes its ticket table as images only, so no price could be read as text. Third-party guides quote CNY 10 park entry and CNY 28 combo in winter; treated as unverified and left blank.

activities.name: Summer Palace (Yiheyuan)
activities.days: Park open daily. The walled gardens inside (Tower of Buddhist Incense, Dehe Yuan, Suzhou Street, museum) close on Mondays except on key public holidays.
activities.hours_low: Park 06:30-19:00, last entry 18:00. Inner gardens 08:30-17:00, last entry 16:30 (1 Nov - 31 Mar)
activities.hours_high: Park 06:00-20:00, last entry 19:00. Inner gardens 08:00-18:00, last entry 17:30 (1 Apr - 31 Oct)
activities.exceptions: Inner gardens closed Mondays outside key holidays. Boats: the official site posted that boat services stopped for the season from 2 Nov 2026; seasonal operation roughly mid-March to mid-November, so expect NO boats in Feb-Mar 2027.
activities.price_note: Low-season park entry CNY 20; combo ticket CNY 50 (park plus inner gardens). Inner-garden singles: Dehe Yuan CNY 5, Tower of Buddhist Incense CNY 10, Suzhou Street CNY 10, Summer Palace Museum CNY 20.
activities.price_two_adults_note: 2 x CNY 50 low-season combo ticket, which is the ticket you actually want.
activities.booking: Online ticketing at yhy.yidyou.cn, linked from the official site.
activities.flag: Kunming Lake boats are seasonal and were shut from 2 Nov 2026 - a winter visit means walking the whole garden. Inner gardens close on Mondays, which is the day most people would otherwise pair this with the Old Summer Palace.

activities.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
activities.type: Restored Ming Great Wall section, UNESCO site
activities.district: Huairou (about 70 km north of the city)
activities.hours_low: 08:00-17:30; ticket sales end 16:30; ticket check 08:00-17:00. Off-season operating hours apply 16 Nov - 15 Mar.
activities.hours_high: Same published window 08:00-17:30 (the site flags off-season 16 Nov - 15 Mar rather than a separate summer table)
activities.exceptions: Off-season schedule 16 Nov - 15 Mar. The operator publishes visitor-volume warnings and closes sections in bad weather.
activities.booking: Real-name tickets via the official reservation centre; passport accepted. Physical ticket offices: north and south gates.
activities.flag: The official ticket page renders its price grid by script, so no price could be read as text and it is left blank. Third-party guides quote CNY 40 admission, CNY 15 shuttle return, CNY 100 cable car one way / CNY 140 return - unverified. Cable car is effectively mandatory in February ice.

activities.name: Lama Temple (Yonghe Temple)
activities.exceptions: Shortened hours and heavier crowding on the 1st and 15th of each lunar month and during Spring Festival. 2027 Spring Festival runs 6-13 Feb; Lantern Festival 20 Feb.
activities.booking: Tickets sold on site and online; the temple does not publish an English booking portal.
activities.flag: The official site did not respond to fetching. The hours and the CNY 25 ticket shown here are the consistent figure across three independent English guides and MUST be re-checked on the temple's own site before relying on them. Prices left blank on purpose.

activities.name: Jingshan Park
activities.type: Imperial hill park with the classic view over the Forbidden City
activities.flag: Official site is live (park office phone 010-64038098, 24 h) but publishes no hours or prices in its page text. Nothing could be verified, so every field is blank. It is the single best free-standing view of the Forbidden City roofs and worth 45 minutes if the weather is clear.

activities.name: Beihai Park
activities.flag: Official site is a single-page script app; park office phone 010-64037972 is the only readable fact. Hours and prices blank. Winter means the lake is not boatable and the White Dagoba island ferry is normally suspended.
